# Local Launch — Complete Company & Site Reference for AI Agents

## Company
- **Name:** Local Launch
- **Type:** Solo-operated web design & local SEO service for small businesses
- **HQ / Service area:** Greenville, SC and Upstate South Carolina (Greenville, Simpsonville, Greer, Mauldin, Five Forks, Travelers Rest, Slater-Marietta, Easley, Fountain Inn)
- **Contact:** zsch21425@gmail.com · (503) 358-5860
- **Pricing:** One-time website builds from $300. No contracts. AI receptionist $19/mo, monthly monitoring $39/mo, website care + SEO/GEO updates $49/mo. Bundles from $300 + $49/mo (Launch), $400 + $69/mo (Grow), $500 + $99/mo (Dominate).

## What Local Launch does
Local Launch builds custom, mobile-first websites and runs local SEO for small businesses: plumbers, mechanics, landscapers, electricians, roofers, HVAC technicians, and painters. The founder is a solo operator in Greenville — clients talk directly to the person building their site, not an account manager.

## Offerings (services & pricing)
One-time services:
- **Website build — $300 one-time:** custom mobile-first site, 30 days support and edits.
- **AI Receptionist setup — $100 setup:** trained on your business, ready to answer and book.
- **Full SEO/GEO/AEO audit — $100 one-time:** Google, AI search, and answer engines — where you stand and what to fix.
- **Google/Meta/Facebook Ads — $49 setup:** campaign setup and ad creative, ready to run.
- **Shorts & Reels — $49 per video:** short-form videos made from your business, ready to post.

Monthly services:
- **AI Receptionist — $19/mo** (after $100 setup): answers calls and chats 24/7, books appointments.
- **Monthly Monitoring — $39/mo:** rankings, reviews, and AI-visibility tracking.
- **Website Care + SEO/GEO Updates — $49/mo:** ongoing edits, content updates, monthly optimization.
- **Automated Social Posts — $49/mo:** scheduled posts keep your pages active.
- **Automated Email & Chat Responses — $49/mo:** instant replies around the clock.

Bundles (month-to-month, no contracts):
- **Launch — $300 + $49/mo:** website build, care + SEO/GEO updates, Google Business Profile setup.
- **Grow — $400 + $69/mo (Most Popular):** everything in Launch, plus full SEO/GEO/AEO audit and monthly rankings & reviews monitoring.
- **Dominate — $500 + $99/mo:** everything in Grow, plus AI receptionist setup + hosting, 24/7 call answering & booking, priority support.

## Key proof point
Redwood Landscaping case study: a landscaping company that was invisible (no website, no Google Business Profile, zero reviews, every after-hours call lost) went to ranking on page one in six weeks — with a 7-page website, AI Yard Visualizer capturing leads daily, 24/7 AI receptionist, and live Google/Yelp/BBB/Nextdoor profiles.

## Positioning vs agencies
Typical marketing agencies charge $2,000–$7,500/month with 6–12 month contracts and treat you as one of 50 accounts. Local Launch: one-time builds from $300, month-to-month services, no contracts, direct access to the builder, AI receptionist + visualizer available, live in under a week.

## FAQ (from the site)
- **How long does it take to build my website?** Most sites are live in under a week. SEO rankings build over the first 60–90 days.
- **Do I need a contract?** No. Everything is pay-as-you-go — one-time setups plus monthly services you can add or cancel anytime.
- **What's included in monthly services?** Website Care + SEO/GEO updates is $49/mo; monthly monitoring of rankings, reviews, and AI visibility is $39/mo; the AI receptionist is $19/mo after a one-time $100 setup. Automated social posts and email/chat responses are $49/mo each.
- **Do you offer ads or social media help?** Yes. Google, Meta, and Facebook ad setup is $49 one-time. Shorts and Reels are $49 per video. Automated social posts and email/chat responses are $49/mo each.
- **Can you help with Google Business Profile?** Yes — GBP optimization is part of the website build and ongoing care plans.
- **What kinds of small businesses do you work with?** Plumbers, mechanics, landscapers, electricians, roofers, HVAC, painters, concrete — any local service business.
- **How is this different from a marketing agency?** Solo operator in Greenville, direct access, AI tools do the heavy lifting, agency-level output at a fraction of the price.
